'''Stephen Sutton Heir To the Empire''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on Decipher Deck Designs.

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Stephen Sutton]]
* '''Published:''' March 1997 (Decipher Deck Designs)
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Hoth]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hoth: Defensive Perimeter (3rd Marker)|Hoth-D-hothdefensiveperimeter.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Heir To the Empire
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PHoth Heir To the Empire Sutton DS 1997.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

I realize I don't have Grand Moff Tarkin or Vader's Saber. But in my game play experience I have not needed them. This deck has never lost and has about 20 wins. Of course the only two people have complete sets of premiere, so me beating them is pretty good.

== Strategy ==

Put the Light Repeating Blaster Rifle at the Defensive Perimeter with the Portable Fusion Generator, and you have Destiny +3. Use Vader with the Dark Jedi saber and disarm Obi, then use The Circle is Now Complete. Danz Borin is an excellent Blizzard Pilot. Avoid space confrontation unless absolutely necessary.
